answers.questionText: At what level is S3 versioning enabled and what are its best practices?
answers.actualAnswerText: S3 versioning is enabled at the bucket level. Best practices include: prevents unintentional overwrite and easy rollback. Two objects with the same key will overwrite but also increment version. versionId is null for items created before versioning was enabled.

answers.questionText: What is the difference between ETL and ELT?
answers.actualAnswerText: ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) is used with Data Warehouse - Schema-on-Write, transform data to meet schema requirements before loading. ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) is used with Data Lake - Schema-on-Read, extract and load data first, then transform on read.
